title: Deux Pieces Breves
identity: Émile Lesieur's Deux pièces brèves is an E-flat saxophone and piano work published by Billaudot (GB3794), copyright 1984; publisher lists 12 pages.

evidence.claim: Billaudot official catalog search result identifies E-flat saxophone and piano, GB3794, 12 pages, copyright 1984.
A 2018 instrumental catalog lists the piece for alto saxophone in E-flat and piano.
A Swiss youth musicians' competition program lists it for a young saxophone contestant in category A, ages 9–11.

review_focus: Inspect both brief pieces for register, articulation and contrast; the youth competition entry indicates one young-player context, not an exclusion from college study.
collection_flag: A competition program documents use by a young player in category A; it is a documented pedagogical-context flag only.
gaps: Publisher page could not be opened; score and recording not inspected.
Old catalog movement names Air tendre/Air gai were not independently verified.
